Select molecule ChEMBL ID, name, max phase, type, and canonical SMILES for compounds in document CHEMBL1148785. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to include canonical SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1148785'. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
